The '''2000–01 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 65th season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece also known as '''Superior Division''' ({{langx|el|Ανώτερη Κατηγορία}}). The season began on 16 September 2000 and ended on 27 May 2001. [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] won their fifth consecutive and 30th Greek title.
